mapper.select: SELECT apcd_iata_code AS apcdIataCode, apcd_icao_code AS apcdIcaoCode, apcd_icao_code AS apcdIcaoCode, apcd_airport_name AS apcdAirportName, apcd_airport_name_s AS apcdAirportNameS, apcd_cnaf_airport_code AS apcdCnafAirportCode, apcd_protocol AS apcdProtocol, apcd_airport_prop AS apcdAirportProp, apcd_vkorg AS apcdVkorg, apcd_vtweg AS apcdVtweg, apcd_bwtar AS apcdBwtar, apcd_werks AS apcdWerks, apcd_vkbur AS apcdVkbur, apcd_vkgrp AS apcdVkgrp, apcd_orgeh AS apcdOrgeh, apcd_persa AS apcdPersa, apcd_btrtl AS apcdBtrtl FROM T_AIRPORT_CODE

SELECT apcd_iata_code AS apcdIataCode, apcd_icao_code AS apcdIcaoCode, apcd_icao_code AS apcdIcaoCode, apcd_airport_name AS apcdAirportName, apcd_airport_name_s AS apcdAirportNameS, apcd_cnaf_airport_code AS apcdCnafAirportCode, apcd_protocol AS apcdProtocol, apcd_airport_prop AS apcdAirportProp, apcd_vkorg AS apcdVkorg, apcd_vtweg AS apcdVtweg, apcd_bwtar AS apcdBwtar, apcd_werks AS apcdWerks, apcd_vkbur AS apcdVkbur, apcd_vkgrp AS apcdVkgrp, apcd_orgeh AS apcdOrgeh, apcd_persa AS apcdPersa, apcd_btrtl AS apcdBtrtl FROM T_AIRPORT_CODE where apcd_airport_prop ='D'

SELECT apcd_iata_code AS apcdIataCode, apcd_icao_code AS apcdIcaoCode, apcd_airport_name AS apcdAirportName, apcd_airport_name_s AS apcdAirportNameS, apcd_cnaf_airport_code AS apcdCnafAirportCode, apcd_protocol AS apcdProtocol, apcd_airport_prop AS apcdAirportProp
,apcd_vkorg AS apcdVkorg, apcd_vtweg AS apcdVtweg, apcd_bwtar AS apcdBwtar, apcd_werks AS apcdWerks, apcd_vkbur AS apcdVkbur, apcd_vkgrp AS apcdVkgrp, apcd_orgeh AS apcdOrgeh, apcd_persa AS apcdPersa, apcd_btrtl AS apcdBtrtl
FROM T_AIRPORT_CODE WHERE apcd_airport_name=#{apcdAirportName} limit 1

SELECT apcd_iata_code AS apcdIataCode, apcd_icao_code AS apcdIcaoCode, apcd_airport_name AS apcdAirportName, apcd_airport_name_s AS apcdAirportNameS, apcd_cnaf_airport_code AS apcdCnafAirportCode, apcd_protocol AS apcdProtocol, apcd_airport_prop AS apcdAirportProp
,apcd_vkorg AS apcdVkorg, apcd_vtweg AS apcdVtweg, apcd_bwtar AS apcdBwtar, apcd_werks AS apcdWerks, apcd_vkbur AS apcdVkbur, apcd_vkgrp AS apcdVkgrp, apcd_orgeh AS apcdOrgeh, apcd_persa AS apcdPersa, apcd_btrtl AS apcdBtrtl
FROM T_AIRPORT_CODE WHERE apcd_airport_name like concat('%',#{apcdAirportName},'%') limit 1
